pages.title: On-device setup
pages.purpose: Parent of the on-device (Termux) setup wizard: app bar plus the controls shared by several steps (connect an existing server, runtime switch, setup log copy). The screen has no app-bar actions or overflow menu; build() picks one of four Scaffolds by state (unsupported card, install progress, installed-runtime view, 3-step wizard list).
gates: SettingsScreen and TermuxProcessesScreen push `TermuxSetupScreen` directly via MaterialPageRoute (library entry itself gated by `platformCapabilities.supportsTermux`)
initState schedules `_refresh()`; app resume re-runs `_refresh()` (or `_verifyAfterTermuxReturn()` after a Termux round trip)

states._Phase.checking: initial; wizard view, all steps idle, step 3 shows "Checking Termux..."
states._Phase.needUnlock: `!capabilities.permissionGranted`, or `TermuxBridge.verifyBridge()` threw, or install threw permission_denied
states._Phase.ready: bridge verified and setup snapshot neither running, failed nor ready (or ready without a saved credential)
states._Phase.installing: install / update / restart / start-existing / runtime switch in progress (own Scaffold)
states._Phase.connected: manager snapshot `isReady` with a saved local profile
states._Phase.failed: snapshot failed, switch pending, bridge/protocol unsupported, or monitoring lost

pages.purpose: Section on the Servers screen for the app-managed Termux server: explicit health check, storage summary and the opt-in foreground crash-recovery policy.

elements.label: Recover a crashed managed server
elements.effect: `_setRecovery(enabled)` -> `ManagedServerRecovery.setEnabled` (persisted per profile in SharedPreferences).

elements.label: Retry disabling recovery
elements.effect: `_setRecovery(false)`.

elements.label: Check recovery status
elements.effect: `recovery.retryCheck()`.

elements.label: Reset retry budget
elements.effect: `_setRecovery(true)` re-enables recovery and resets the 3-attempt budget.

elements.label: Check status
elements.effect: `_check()`: `TermuxBridge.status()` then `TermuxBridge.storage()`.

elements.label: Open setup controls
elements.effect: Host callback `onManage`; ServersScreen passes `_openTermuxSetup` = `Navigator.pushNamed('/termux-setup')` then bumps `_termuxRevision`.

pages.title: Something is still running on this phone
pages.purpose: Workspace line shown only while an orphaned Termux helper has burned more than 10 minutes of CPU (polled every 60s).
gates: host gate at lib/ui/screens/workspace_screen.dart:632 to be read by the workspace agent

elements.label: Something is still running on this phone — {name} has used {cpu} of CPU with nothing waiting on it
elements.effect: Pushes `MaterialPageRoute(TermuxProcessesScreen)`; re-checks on return.

pages.title: LIVE OUTPUT / LAST OUTPUT
pages.purpose: Reusable setup log panel (selectable, ANSI-stripped, colored lines) with one copy button; hosted in my pages (termux-setup*, termux-storage) and in TeamPhoneOnboardingBlock.

elements.label: Copy output (or host-supplied `copyTooltip`)
elements.effect: Calls host `onCopy`; disabled when `onCopy == null`. In TeamPhoneOnboardingBlock the host passes `_log.isEmpty ? null : _copyLog` (team_phone_onboarding.dart:746, 855).

notPages.reason: pure function `setupUiMessage(l10n, message)` mapping raw setup/bridge messages to localized text; no widget, surface or interactive element

notes: TermuxSetupScreen has no AppBar actions, overflow menu or separate advanced/troubleshooting screen: all four Scaffolds use a title-only AppBar (lib/ui/screens/termux_setup_screen.dart:1566, 1619, 1641, 2119). The closest things to "advanced" are the "Show command" ExpansionTile (1856), the "Setup help" ExpansionTile (2281) and the failure-report copy button.

Probable dead branches in `_setupChoices` (termux_setup_screen.dart:2401-2410 "Start installed OpenCode", 2473-2488 "Reinstall & start"): `_setupChoices` is only used by the wizard view (1904, 2051), but whenever `_installation.openCodeVersion != null` the getter `_knownRuntime` (55-67) is non-null and build() (1629-1638) switches to `_buildInstalledRuntime()` for ready/failed phases. Recorded with a gate note rather than omitted.
"Stop local server" (termux_setup_screen.dart:1999, 2235) calls `_stopServer()` with no confirmation sheet, unlike restart/update/switch.
Runtime-switch, restart and replace confirm sheets are opened without `destructive: true`; the ledger marks their confirm buttons destructive by effect (termux_setup_screen.dart:395, 732, 2511).

`termux-setup-installed-reinstall` can chain two sheets (replace-installed at 2511, then unchecked-install at 2525 when `_installation == null`); in practice `installedVersion != null` implies `_installation != null`, so only one appears per tap.

TeamPhoneOnboardingBlock (lib/ui/widgets/team_phone_onboarding.dart, not assigned to h-termux) is embedded in TermuxSetupScreen at termux_setup_screen.dart:2018 and 2266; only its `onOpenWorkspace` callback is recorded here. Its owner should emit `embeddedIn: ["TermuxSetupScreen"]` (host pages `termux-setup-connected`, `termux-setup-installed`).

termux_processes_screen.dart:251-259: the details sheet has a protected-process branch, but protected rows call `onProtected` instead of `onOpen` (line 522), so that branch is currently unreachable from the list.
Host-side gates for TermuxAttentionLine (lib/ui/screens/workspace_screen.dart:632) were not read; ServersScreen hosts were read only around lines 97-124 and 677-689.

showConfirmSheet elements carry `file: lib/ui/widgets/confirm_sheet.dart` with lines 68 (confirm) and 86 (cancel); the default cancel label is the hard-coded English string "Cancel" (confirm_sheet.dart:15), not l10n.
